about: Single source of market facts. status = primary (checked at the regulator or official page on verified_on), secondary (press or secondary source), unverified (carried over, not re-checked). Any row that is not primary, and any field listed in unverified_fields, carries '(verify before deployment)' in a deliverable. market_status closed_pending = produce the flows with the banner at the top of the output; counsel confirms legal status before any send.

UK.name: United Kingdom

consent.notes: SR 5.1.12, in force 1 May 2025: opt-in per product and per channel, opt-out by default. Model as consent_<product>_<channel> attributes.

bonus_rules.notes: SR 5.1.1, in force 19 Jan 2026: wagering requirement at most 10x; no offer requiring two or more gambling types. Whether separate betting and casino offers may share one email is unconfirmed (verify before deployment).

UK.notes: Consent and bonus rules primary. Register, API check and helpline from secondary research. Soft opt-in posture is a question for counsel (LQ_CON_01).

DE.name: Germany
DE.register: OASIS national self-exclusion register; LUGAS cross-operator limit and activity files

bonus_rules.notes: No shipped bonus fact; route to LQ_LIC_04.

time_windows: Slot and casino advertising 21:00-06:00 only; whether this covers direct CRM email is a legal question
DE.notes: LUGAS (primary, GGL FAQ, 2026-10-20): the cross-operator monthly deposit limit is usually EUR 1-1,000, not a hard cap; higher limits are the operator's decision and an increase applies after 7 days. Store as lugas_limit_eur / lugas_limit_set_at. Never message a player to raise it.

bonus_rules.notes: Spellagen 14:9: a bonus only at the first play occasion with the operator (first_play_bonus_used); recurring bonuses and VIP perks are not offered.
No shipped bonus fact; route to LQ_LIC_04.

NL.name: Netherlands
NL.register: CRUKS national register, checked at registration and log-in

bonus_rules.notes: No shipped bonus fact; route to LQ_LIC_04. A proposal to ban online advertising and bonuses is unconfirmed.

NL.notes: OpenOverGokken replaced Loket Kansspel (secondary). Deposit limits EUR 150 (ages 18-23) / EUR 350 (24+) need personal contact before they are exceeded; monthly net deposits above EUR 300 / EUR 700 trigger an affordability check. Store nl_affordability_check_status and nl_staff_contact_done.

BR.name: Brazil
BR.status_note: closed pending MP 1.394/2026 (25 Sep 2026); licences end ~25 Oct 2026
BR.banner: MARKET STATUS: BR closed pending MP 1.394/2026 (25 Sep 2026); licences end ~25 Oct 2026. Counsel must confirm legal status before any send.

bonus_rules.notes: Portaria SPA/MF 1.231/2024: no deposit-conditional bonus or reward; no marketing to self-excluded players; 18+ warning; ordinance number in advertising (Snippet br_ordinance_number).

BR.notes: MP 1.394/2026 (primary, Senado summary, 2026-10-20) bans fixed-odds betting and its advertising; licences in force end 30 days after publication. Portaria rules secondary. Any lapse date of the MP is unconfirmed (verify before deployment). Hold mechanism: the backend sets country_license_status = "pending" for every BR player until counsel confirms in writing (LQ_LIC_05); the gate condition country_license_status == "licensed" then blocks every BR marketing send while the flows stay built.
